title: Pure Mist Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Raspberry captures the bright, tangy sweetness of ripe Raspberries for a smooth and refreshing vape. This simple yet vibrant e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy classic fruit flavours with a touch of natural tartness. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers tailored VG/PG ratios to suit different vaping preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Raspberry is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
